data.content_ref: inline:The isolated artifact 120dd644125e CONTRADICTS SRC_002's anchoring-artifact claim: where SRC_002 holds that checklist-driven agreement is a compositional artifact of shared anchoring rather than truth-tracking, the isolated artifact's causal-mechanism stance predicts that checklist-driven aggregation genuinely cancels cue-omission errors and thus tracks truth — provided the checklist encodes the diagnostic cues the expert would use. The contradiction is REFUTED IF it can be shown that the checklist encodes a wrong model, in which case high inter-rater agreement coexists with systematically wrong majority verdicts and the 'genuine gain' claim collapses into the anchoring artifact; or if the checklist's cue-set is demonstrably a lossy compression of the expert's tacit knowledge, making checklist-anchored panel accuracy an upper-bounded shadow of expert accuracy rather than an independent truth-tracking process.
